title: DE-BIASED REPRESENTATION LEARNING FOR FAIRNESS WITH UNRELIABLE LABELS
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its entire focus is on a technical framework for learning fair data representations from labels that may be biased, with experiments conducted on datasets where sensitive attributes are race and gender.
